criteria.test: FE-A1.3-W03-AC01 execution: retained questions answers citations and outcomes restore in a new document
criteria.observation: Actual managed-model browser delivery, new-document restoration and anchored PostgreSQL paging preserve original question, answer, citation labels and terminal outcomes.

criteria.test: FE-A1.3-W03-AC02 execution: actual readable content is backed by retained Artifacts rather than a metadata view
criteria.observation: Canonical Thread/Work views remain metadata; exact retained private input and registered result Artifacts provide readable conversation bytes.

criteria.test: FE-A1.3-W03-AC03 execution: exact actor Project and immutable model input scope survives restart
criteria.observation: Exact actor/Project reads and the immutable original model-input manifest remain owner-bound after repository restart. Explicit reviewed owner permission grants only RunProjectCopilot, creates no Work until Ask, and cannot authorize general Work management, examination or Apply.

criteria.test: FE-A1.3-W03-AC04 execution: completed failed cancelled and imported content resolves to existing native owners
criteria.observation: Native completed/failed/cancelled conversation and explicit historical adoption resolve to actual canonical Thread, Run and Work; writing retains its native basis without a scientific snapshot.

criteria.test: FE-A1.3-W03-AC05 execution: actual inquiry Work Review and cycle lineage remains exact on replay
criteria.observation: A positive PostgreSQL function resolves actual inquiry, additional Work, Review, hypothesis, assessment, posture and cycle records; repeated reads create no second Work.

boundary: Canonical ownership and retained readable advisory conversation only. Provider internal CPU, memory, network, tokens and price remain unavailable; unknown values never satisfy applicable hard limits. Historical adoption records actual import Work and preserves original bytes without reconstructing original execution authority. Proposal decisions/commands, progressive AG-UI activities/interrupts, native examiners, reactive Workspace graph cycles and A1 product acceptance remain open required ledger items.
